steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Egwi, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HAA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Egwi, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station Egwi, Etche LGA**

The interpreted VES model at Egwi comprises five layers with resistivities increasing progressively with depth: Layer 1 (295.88 Ω·m, 0.545 m), Layer 2 (798.6 Ω·m, to 4.14 m), Layer 3 (864.62 Ω·m, to 6.29 m), Layer 4 (1810.2 Ω·m, to 37.25 m), and Layer 5 (5634.2 Ω·m, semi-infinite basement/aquifer zone).

Applying the curve-type convention to the three consecutive triplets: Layers 1-2-3 (r1<r2<r3) → A; Layers 2-3-4 (r2<r3<r4) → A; Layers 3-4-5 (r3<r4<r5) → A. All three letters are identical (A), so the correct curve designation is simply **A-type**, reflecting a continuously increasing resistivity profile typical of weathered/lateritic overburden grading into competent basement.

The file label "HAA-type" does not match this computed sequence, as an H in the first position would require r1 > r2, which is not observed here. This discrepancy should be corrected before finalizing the geophysical log for the drilling team.
